本仪表盘由 GitHub Actions 定时工作流自动生成。它定期抓取 Hyp: This dashboard is generated automatically by a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow. It periodically fetches the public Hypixel SkyBlock API and compares each response with the previous snapshot; added / removed / modified fields are recorded in code-review style in the change log above. The “current version” at the top of the page comes from the version field of the collections and skills resource endpoints: because Hypixel rolls out updates in batches, the two endpoints do not necessarily switch at the same time, so a new version is confirmed only when both versions match; while they differ, the last stable version is kept and “version syncing” is shown, avoiding back-and-forth version jumps. Version switches are recorded separately in the “version history” panel and are not mixed into the endpoint change log, and that panel likewise keeps only the last 30 days and at most 20 records. Bazaar price fluctuations are filtered out — only structural additions and removals of products are tracked. The packs endpoint always takes the version with the highest packFormat value (that number changes as MC updates), downloads and unpacks the zip when the official hash changes, and compares the additions, removals and modifications of the files inside the pack by file content hash; modified text files show only the changed fragment in red and green, and added files are marked green only. The Bingo endpoint (bingo) records the publish time, start and end time of each round and lists all goals in a 5×5 grid (left to right, top to bottom; click a cell to read the full text); countdowns hand the epoch milliseconds of start / end to the browser to tick every second, unaffected by Actions fetch delays; Minecraft color codes (§) in goal text are rendered with the official palette, and server-wide progress is display-only and never part of the change comparison. The firesales endpoint is fetched again on every run (officials may adjust time, quantity or price before a sale starts); each round becomes its own card showing price and quantity, and the “show extra data” button expands all rounds together with the raw JSON. If any endpoint or pack download fails, the run leaves every piece of data in the repository untouched.

监控收藏、技能、物品、集市、资源包、限时特卖与 Bingo 任务七个端点，并解压: Monitors seven endpoints — collections, skills, items, bazaar, packs, firesales and Bingo goals — and unpacks resource packs to diff the files inside. Data is fetched on a schedule by GitHub Actions; times are shown in Beijing time (UTC+8) by default and the time zone can be switched in the top right corner; the interface supports 103 languages. At the bottom of the page a 5×5 grid summarizes every goal of the current Bingo, and countdowns are computed locally in the browser.
